raw:
US-10-01 is implemented and committed on feature/US-10-01. Gates are green. The run on the final head 94a466b gives: TC-10-01, 02, 03 and 06 pass; TC-10-05 is manual-only; TC-10-04 and TC-10-07 are blocked.

Why those two are blocked: TC-10-04 (all three steps) and step 4 of TC-10-07 need a description to be sent and the "New event" window to open. That is reading a description, which this story's Out of scope leaves to US-10-02. I did not pull it forward and did not edit either test case (DEC-215). In this story, Enter in the box only asks Ollama again whether it can be used.

What else needs to know:
- **Ollama client:** it lives in calendar-core (`crates/core/src/ollama.rs`), with a fake Ollama behind a new `fake` feature. calendar-core now depends on `ureq` and `url`. Both are at the versions calendar-google already uses, so `Cargo.lock` gains no new crate, but the manifests changed and the dependency signal may fire (DEC-216).
- **Tests drive the whole app:** they live in `crates/app/src/description.rs` and use egui_kittest on the app itself. To make that possible, `CalendarApp::preview` is now `pub(crate)`.
- **Evidence script:** new `scripts/cargo_report.py`. It turns `cargo test -- --show-output` into the Playwright-shaped report that `collect_run.py` reads. Tests announce each test-case step with `og-step <TC> <n> — …`, so a step that never ran is shown as missing.
- **Bug fixed along the way:** pressing `q` used to type "q" into the box it focused. The keystroke is now dropped.
